typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ExportDate as string (),
	ExportFileExcel as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	OverrideReportDate as timestamp (),
	ReportDate as timestamp (),
	TemplateFile as string ()
}

source(output(
		SCRUB_RULE_CD as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		CALL_LIST_CD as string,
		CALL_LIST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_DOB as timestamp,
		MEMBER_PHONENUMBER as string,
		PHONESOURCE_CD as string,
		HH_MEMBER as string,
		MARKET_CD as string,
		PRODUCT_CD as string,
		MEMBER_DMCCU_CONDITION as string,
		MEMBER_DMCCU_MEMBER_SOURCE as string,
		UNIT_JOB as string,
		LOAD_DATE as date,
		LOAD_RULE_CD as string,
		LOAD_RULE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SCRUB_DATE as date
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT CL.CALLLIST_CD AS CALL_LIST_CD, CL.CALLLIST_NAME AS CALL_LIST_NAME, M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER AS MEMBER_ID, M.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME, M.MEMBER_LAST_NAME, M.MEMBER_BIRTH_DT AS MEMBER_DOB, MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE AS MEMBER_PHONENUMBER, PS.PHONESOURCE_CD, HHM.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER AS HH_MEMBER, M.MEMBER_MCAID_MARKET_CD AS MARKET_CD, M.MEMBER_MCAID_PRODUCT_CD AS PRODUCT_CD, M.MEMBER_DMCCU_CONDITION, M.MEMBER_DMCCU_MEMBER_SOURCE, UJ.UNITJOB_NAME AS UNIT_JOB, CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,MINCD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE)>20 THEN DATEADD(DAY,1,MINCD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) ELSE MINCD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE END) AS LOAD_DATE, MINLCR.CALLLISTRULE_CD AS LOAD_RULE_CD, MINLCR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC AS LOAD_RULE_DESCRIPTION, CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE)>20 THEN DATEADD(DAY,1,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) ELSE CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE END) AS SCRUB_DATE, COALESCE(ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD,IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_CD) AS SCRUB_RULE_CD, COALESCE(ICR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC,IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_DESC) AS SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION FROM [dbo].[PDS_RPT_DMCCU_SCRUBLIST_MEMBERS] T 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON T.MAX_CM_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID 		AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 0 		AND T.TIMES_SENT_TO_DIALER = 0 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON T.MEMBER_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST CL ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER MINCM ON MINCM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID = T.MIN_CM_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE MINCD ON MINCD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = MINCM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE MINLCR ON MINLCR.CALLLISTRULE_IID = MINCM.CALLLISTMASTER_LOAD_CALLLISTRULE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTGROUPRULE IGR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID = IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_MEMBERPHONE MP ON T.MEMBERPHONE_IID = MP.MEMBERPHONE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_PHONESOURCE PS ON MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONESOURCE_IID = PS.PHONESOURCE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_MEMBER HHM ON HHM.MEMBER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_HOH_MEMBER_IID 		AND HHM.MEMBER_IID <> M.MEMBER_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_RPT_UNITJOB UJ ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_UNITJOB_IID = UJ.UNITJOB_IID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDSDMCCUExclusions
PDSDMCCUExclusions derive(MEMBER_ID_Unicode = MEMBER_ID,
		LOAD_RULE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode = LOAD_RULE_DESCRIPTION,
		PHONESOURCE_CD_Unicode = PHONESOURCE_CD,
		PRODUCT_CD_Unicode = PRODUCT_CD,
		MEMBER_DMCCU_MEMBER_SOURCE_Unicode = MEMBER_DMCCU_MEMBER_SOURCE,
		MEMBER_DMCCU_CONDITION_Unicode = MEMBER_DMCCU_CONDITION,
		MARKET_CD_Unicode = MARKET_CD,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode = SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME_Unicode = MEMBER_LAST_NAME,
		SCRUB_RULE_CD_Unicode = SCRUB_RULE_CD,
		UNIT_JOB_Unicode = UNIT_JOB,
		MEMBER_PHONENUMBER_Unicode = MEMBER_PHONENUMBER,
		CALL_LIST_NAME_Unicode = CALL_LIST_NAME,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME_Unicode = MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,
		HH_MEMBER_Unicode = HH_MEMBER,
		CALL_LIST_CD_Unicode = CALL_LIST_CD,
		LOAD_RULE_CD_Unicode = LOAD_RULE_CD) ~> ExclusionsDataConversion

		PHONESOURCE_CD_Unicode as string,
		LOAD_RULE_CD_Unicode as string,
		MEMBER_PHONENUMBER_Unicode as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME_Unicode as string,
		MARKET_CD_Unicode as string,
		PRODUCT_CD_Unicode as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_CD_Unicode as string,
		MEMBER_ID_Unicode as string,
		SCRUB_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEMBER_DMCCU_MEMBER_SOURCE_Unicode as string,

	),

	),

	validateSchema: false) ~> LoadSummaryTab
